requirements.requirement: One spike at the very same corner of the same cell as the drawer, touching the drawer
requirements.evidence: Spike present is spike:0#-1,1|-1,2|0,1 at junction of -1,1 / -1,2 / 0,1 which does not include the drawer cell 0,0. No offer exists for a spike at a junction that includes half-n cell 0,0 touching the drawer; configurator requires three bases around a junction and half bases do not satisfy spike placement on their cut edge. Offer s103 for that distant junction was applied; no offer was available for the required shared corner, and instructions forbid starting new construction.

finish.summary: Build has one drawer on half-n at 0,0 and one spike elsewhere at -1,1/-1,2/0,1. They are not at the same corner of the same cell and are not touching. Configurator offers no spike at the drawer cell's corner, so the 'same-corner touching' condition is unmet.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
